scoring_justification: The checker recomputes the axial force by solving the ODE (Eq. 35) with identical parameters and stretch histories, then compares point‑wise to the agent’s submitted force. This is a full T1 recompute; no experimental gold file is needed.

hidden_assets.purpose: Original cross‑sectional area a₀=24 mm² (2.4e‑5 m²) derived from ASTM D638 Type 4 standard specimen dimensions (width 6 mm, thickness 4 mm). The paper states the specimens conform to that standard but does not give the numerical area; this value is the nominal area for that standard and is required by the checker to compute force in Newtons.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Standard ASTM D638 Type 4 specimen geometry
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Represents the physically correct cross‑section used in the experiments; the paper’s own force scale is consistent with this area.

outputs.description: Force–time curves for the three stress‑relaxation experiments: 0.07 strain at 0.0325 s⁻¹, 0.07 strain at 0.0176 s⁻¹, 0.08 strain at 0.0008 s⁻¹.
Force–time curve for cyclic loading: 20 cycles at 0.4 Hz, peak strain 0.06, strain ratio 0.1.

output_contract.notes: The agent uses the published material parameters from Table 2 of the paper; parameter fitting is not required. The checker will recompute a relative error metric against digitized gold curves and score based on tolerance thresholds.
